description: This file contains Makefile definitions for device configurations and build procedures within an OpenWrt setup, specifically for various ARM-based microchips and evaluation boards. It defines device-specific parameters, build steps for SD cards, and references external files like device tree source files and scripts.

methods.name: Device/default-nand
methods.description: Defines NAND flash device parameters such as block size and UBI filesystem options.

methods.name: Build/at91-sdcard
methods.description: Build procedure for creating SD card images, including formatting, copying boot files, and generating compressed images.

methods.name: Device/microchip_sama5d2-icp
methods.description: Defines configuration for the Microchip SAMA5D2 ICP device, including device tree and size parameters.

methods.name: Device/microchip_sama5d2-xplained
methods.description: Defines configuration for the Microchip SAMA5D2 Xplained evaluation board.

methods.name: Device/microchip_sama5d27-som1-ek
methods.description: Configuration for the SAMA5D27 SOM1 Evaluation Kit.

methods.name: Device/microchip_sama5d27-wlsom1-ek
methods.description: Configuration for the SAMA5D27 Wireless SOM1 Evaluation Kit.

methods.name: Device/microchip_sama5d2-ptc-ek
methods.description: Configuration for the SAMA5D2 PTC Evaluation Kit.

methods.name: Device/microchip_sama5d3-xplained
methods.description: Configuration for the SAMA5D3 Xplained evaluation board.

methods.name: Device/microchip_sama5d4-xplained
methods.description: Configuration for the SAMA5D4 Xplained evaluation board.
